name: Yantai North Andre Juice Co., Ltd.
summary: Yantai North Andre Juice Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, sale, and supply of concentrated fruit juices in the Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, and Oceania. It offers fruit and vegetable juices, fruit pulp, essence, biological feed, and related products. The company also provides apple, pear, peach, orange and lemon, strawberry, and clear sweet potato and haw juice concentrates. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
